title: Spontaneous joy with a free direction

captions.emotions: Feeling the excitement of chosen movement

meaning: Spontaneous leisure gains a living direction when wanting more pleasure allows a shared choice and a free measure of participation.
text: A new pleasure can be tried without a detailed plan and then given a direction. The Fool in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps begin an activity spontaneously. The Empress in energy leans towards multiplying pleasant possibilities. The Chariot in emotions offers excitement in movement towards something chosen. A light beginning can quickly acquire wishes to fit in more. Both benefit from hearing which possibility actually interests each now before leisure becomes a pursuit of variety.

For example, you happen to notice small boats for hire beside a park. Trying one appeals, followed by drinks, a fair and another walk. **Spontaneous joy allows one freely chosen direction.** You can begin with a short time on the water and ask about continuing after returning. Excitement gains an understandable object while other possibilities remain free. You need not fit in each to recognise an unexpected shared activity as sufficiently vivid and worthy of a warm memory.

The difficulty is treating initial enthusiasm as agreement to the entire next list. The route expands faster than both people’s desire, and stopping feels like an obstacle to an evening gaining speed. A small choice restores each person’s participation. If the boat is enough for one, pleasure in it can remain without a requirement to support every attractive idea nearby.
